(31)dal 'byor ni gang la snying po len pa'i gzhi dang*/skyes su gsum gyi lam ni de la snying po len tshul yin pas skyes bu chung ba'i lam rim du ma bas

tei:div.tei:p: (31)dal 'byor ni gang la snying po len pa'i gzhi dang*/ skyes su gsum gyi lam ni de la snying po len tshul yin pas skyes bu chung ba'i lam rim du ma bsdus la 'byor ba'i skabs/ bstan la zhugs zhes pa bstan pa la zhugs pa'i mig ltos dge 'dun gzhan bzhugs pa las rang nyid zhugs pa ni ma yin no/ gzhan phyir snying brtse'i sgras yon bdag dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyis ka sdud la/ bla ma dang dge grogs byad las gcig pas bla mar bsdu'o/ las 'brasal la dang po nges sa gtso che bas las brgya pa sogs la dpe bltas byed/ de nas dmigs pa'i rnam pa blo la gzod sgom/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dus rang nyid dmyal sogs su skye ba mi bsgom/ de la skye ba'i rgyu rang rgyud la bsam gyis mi khyab pas des rjes su dpag nas/ dmyal (32)sogs su skye nges par sgom/ stobs bzhi'i skabs rten stobs bshags yul gtso bo ma yin/ rang gi rgyud kyi skyabs 'gro sogs dge ba de nyid bshags pa'i rten yin gsungs/ sems kyi stobs chen kyi lung gi skabs/ 'bras bu byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa dang*/ de'i rgyu rdzogs smin sbyang ba la sems stobs che ba dang*/ sems can 'dren pa'i sems stobs kyi che ba gsung rgyun/ sdug bsngal gsum gyis skabs khyad pa 'du byed ni/ khyab pa ni srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar la khyab pa dang*/ 'du byed ni las nyon gyi 'du byed pa'i rnam smin phung po dang yul gzugs sogs rnams yin pas 'di la yid 'byung dgos/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni zag bcas bde ba yin la/ de'i mtha' ni sdug bsngal gyi yin 'gyur ba de la yid 'byung dka' la/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug (33)bsngal la yid sun nas mi 'dod pas de sgom dgos pa ma yin gsungs/ yul dmigs pa'i ngo bo gtso sems/ yul dmigs pa'i khyad par sems byung yin pas 'di gsung rgyun yin/ bar do'i sems ni/

'chi kha'i ngang snyam pa'i bag chags kyis byung la/ de'i lus ni snga ma'i lus kyi bag chags las byung la/ rigs drug gi lus ni 'chi kha'i rigs drug gi gang la sems kyi 'phen pas so/ 'jigs srid sogs ni 'bras bu srid pa 'byung bas 'bras ming rgyu la btags pa'o/ rnam 'grol las/ rnam shes min pa'i nyer len gyi/ zhes pa'i skabs/ sngon mtha' thog mde du snyams pa'i skabs bzhin/ byang sems rnams kyis tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i stobs kyis lus dang longs spyod kyi khyad par gong nas gong du 'phel nas rgyun mthar/ lus kyi nyer len gyi (34)rgyu byas/ mnyam bzhag gi ye shes des lhan rkyenabyas nas sangs rgyas gzugs sku 'grub/ mnyam bzhag de'i nyer len gyi rgyu byas lus kyi lhan rkyen byas nas chos sku 'grub la/ 'o na gzugs bem pos ji ltar ye shes kyi rgyu byed snyams na/ gzugs yin na bem poyin mi dgos te/ sngags kyi sgyu lus bzhin yin pas rje rin po ches/ go ba thun min sngags 'dis rnyed pa yin gsung*/ mdo rang lam nas rnam pa kun tu rgyu 'bras 'dra bar dgos pa min gsung*/ lam rim gyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga 'di smon sems len tshul dang*/ 'jug sems len tshul byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u'i 'grol par zhal 'phang la/ spyir sems can sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa de dus nam yin kyang bskyod pa phan yon cher 'byung mdo smon sems mtshan nyid pa ma yin la/ smon (35)sems la sems de mi gtong snyam pa'i dam bca' dgos/ sems bskyed gsum las dang po 'dod chen po bskyed dgos/ phyi ma gnyis ni sems bskyed kyi ngo bos dbye ba med la/ sems sbyang ba'i mthu thob pas tshogs rdzogs pa'i sgo'i khyad par yin gsung*/ chos dang gang zag gi bdag gnyis po de rnam pa'i sgo nas rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa la gcig dmigs pa'i sgo nas rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa la gcig

de dgag pa'i gtan tshig yang gcig stong nyid kyi khyab pa nges pa la gcig pas/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rigs pa des chos la dpyad na rtogs nus pa dang*/ rtogs kyang me sgom de rgya che ba la mi mos pa dang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams bzang po yin par 'phags pas rtogs kyang thob mi nus pa nams pa bzhin no/ spyor chos (36)dang gang zag gi 'dzin pa gnyis so la bdag gi khyad par du byas pas dmigs kyang*/ nga'i mig zhes nga'i ngo bor dmigs pa gang zag gi bdag 'dzin/ nga'i mig zhes mig rang nyid la dmigs pa chos bdag gi 'dzin pa/ spyir gnas ma bu ma gtogs pa'i rang sdes gang zag rgyun gyi chos btags yod zhes 'dod kyang*/ rang rgyud pa man chad kyi btags lugs de btags yod yin kyang yod lugs yul rang gi ngos nas kyang cung zad yod/ blos kyang btags pa'i gnyis tshogs la 'dod/ thal 'gyur bas btags yod re rwa bzhin blos phar btags ma gtogs yul la med par bzhed/ yang dgag bya'i ngos 'dzin la/ dgag bya yul phyin ci log yin la/ yul de gtan med yin pas blo la 'char rgyu med/ blos 'dzin tshul la yul de yod na ji ltar 'dzin pa yin min gyi blo'i 'dzin tshul (37)de 'char dgos la/ de la dgag bya ngos 'dzin khyab che ba'i skabs/ yod pa dang rang bzhin gyis grub pa gnyis gcig tu bzhed pa yin pas rjes thob yod pas don dam du yod par 'gyur ba'i gnad de la thug pas rten 'byung mi 'grub pa yin no/ dpe na yod pa dang rang bzhin gyis yod pa gnyis la khyad par yod la med pa dang rang bzhin med pa gnyis la khyad par yod par bzhed dgos/ sngar gyi nyan thos kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rigs pa des ltos med du chos bdag med rtogs gsung pa la gsar mas mkhas pa rnams kyis/ dngos su gang zag gi bdag med rtogs kyang shugs kyis chos bdag med rtogs par 'dod pa yod kyang*/ shugs rtogs ni min te/

dngos rtogs la yul de la sgro 'dogs ched pa nges pa 'dren pa gnyis ka yod la/ shugs rtogs la yul de la sgro 'dogs (38)chod kyang nges pa ma rnyed pas gzod yul de la blo byang na nges par nga 'dren pa yin kyang*/ 'di ni gang zag dang chos gnyis yul yang mi gcig la/ gang zag la sgro 'dogs chod pas chos la sgro 'dogs mi chod pas/ 'on kyang snga ma des mthus/ blo phyi ma chos bdag med rtogs pa'i nus pa bzhag pa de yin gsung*/ des na dang po nas dgag bya la don dam gyi khyad par sbyar te/ bden gnyis 'jal ba'i tshad ma phye ste 'jal dgos gsungs so/ chos dang don la sems pa gnyis sgra spyi dang don spyi la dmigs pa'i khyad par yin la/ rnam par rtog pa'i gzugs brnyan dang rnam par mi rtog pa'i gzugs brnyan gnyis ni dper na ka ba'i don spyi dang stong pa'i don spyid gnyis yin gsung*/ yang bka' rgyud 'di pa'i lugs la/ don dam dpyod pa'i tshad ma des ka ba'i gnas tshul dpyod pa yin la ka ba yod med (39)dpyad pa ma yin pas don dam par ka ba med par gzhal ba yin gyi ka ba med par rnyed pa ma yin te dper na mig shes kyi sgra ma rnyed kyang sgra med par rnyed pa min pa bzhin 'di ni yul can tha dad pas ste/ 'phags pa rnams kyis ka ba'i rang bzhin gzigs pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir ro/ chos can mthun snang du grub pa dbu ma rang rgyud pa man chad la 'dod kyang*/ 'dir pha rol po'i khas blangs la brten te tshul gsum po khas len kyang*/ rang lugs la tshul gsum rang rgyud du grub pa ni med de blos phar bzhag pa tsam ma gtog pa'i rang rgyud man chad kyi yul rang ngos nas grub pa mi 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ yang thal bzlog skabs slob dpon legs ldan gyi bzhed pa la chos can mthun snang ba med de/ legs ldan byed/ dgag bya yul rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i bden 'dzin dgag dgos par bzhed pas (40)tha snyad pa'i yul rang gi ngos nas grub pa'i rang mtshan 'jog na snga ma las nyams la/

de las mi nyams na/ yul rang mtshan gyi grub par 'jog pa'i lugs phyi ma nyams zhes dgongs pa'o/ yang thal rang gnyis dgag bya la don dam gyi khyad par sbyar ba 'di khyad par ma yin te/ tha snyad du yul rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag byar byed mi byed kyi khyad par yin par bzhed de/ zhi gnas dgos pa sems las rung thob pa dang*/ lhag mthong bden med kyi nges pa thob pa'i phyir sgom par gsung*/ drang nges rnam 'byed skabs/ kun btags la rang rgyud pa man chad kyi ming 'jug pa'i 'jug yul yul rang gi ngos nas rang mtshan gyi grub pa ste de yang mtshan rdzas grub 'di ma yin te yul rang gi sdod lugs kyi grub pa 'di yin par bzhed la/ dbu ma pas yul rang gi ngos nas ma yin par/ bum pa'i ldog (41)pa chig rkyang de don spyi dang*/ de bum pa'i rnam pa blo la shar ba gnyis kyi snga ma yin la de shes bya la yod tsam du bzhed do/ des na blo rtog bcas kyi dngos yul don spyi zhen yul rang mtshon yin la/ blo rtog mde kyi dngos zhen 'jug gsum gyi yul rang mtshan yin gsung*/ dpe na kun brtags ni spyi mtshan de yin/ yul rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub pa'i brjod du med pa/ der snang dang der stong tshogs pa de gzhan dbang*/ yongs grub la/ kun brtags ming 'jug pa'i 'jug yul rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa dang gzhan dbang gzung 'dzin rgyang chad kyi stong pa de gnyis yin gsung*/ lhan cig dmigs nges skabs kyi dmigs nges la/ thog ma med pa'i mngon par brjod pa'i bag chags kyis sad pa'i stobs kyi nges par gsung la/ dpe na mdo sde bas bum pa'i (42)spyi ming 'jug pa'i 'jug yul bum pa rang gi steng du dgos te/ ka ba la ka bar 'jug bum pa la ka ba mi 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan ni ka ba'i spyi mtshan rang mtshan la yod med yin par gsung*/ 'dis ni de ltar spyi mtshan de ltar ma grub ste ming 'jug pa'i 'jug yul rang mtshan kyis ma grub kyang*/

spyir don spyi don la 'khrul bas 'khrul ba yin kyang*/ ka ba la ka ba'i mig 'jug bum pa la ka ba'i ming mi 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshin/ thog ma med pa'i mngonapar brjod pa'i bag chags kyi stobs kyis ka ba la ka ba'i ming 'jug bum pa mi 'jug pas bag chags kyi dbang gis 'khrul pa yin kyang bsru mi bsru 'thad par gsung ste/ dper na dbu la nas bden pa yin na bya byed mi 'thad par ston pa bzhin no/ dpe na gnyis stong gi shes pa yang de'i grub ste/ ming 'jug pa'i 'jug gzhi (43)rang mtshan gyis ma grub kyang thog ma med pa'i mngon par brjod pa'i bag chags tsam snang zhing de las gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ yang sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mngon sum mkhyen pa yang ming 'jug pa'i 'jug gzhi rang mtshan gyis grub pa med par sgom pas/ yul khol bur bcad de 'dzin pa'i ming 'jug pa'i 'jug gzhi rang mtshan gyi grub pa de spang bas yul thams cad mkhyen pa gsung*/ dpe na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pas mngon brjod kyi bag chags spang bas chos mngon sum mkhyen la/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyis gzhan gyi sems kyi rjes su mthun pa sems kyi rnam pa mngon sum shes pa yin gyi pha rol po'i sems kyi rang mtshan mkhyen pa ni ma yin te pha rol po'i sems de la rang mtshan gtad pa'i nus pa med pa'i (44)phyir gsungs deyang bag chags de la gsum 'jigs lta'i bag chags kyi 'jigs lta 'byung la/ yul don sems gsum gyi bag chags kyi yul don sems gsum po snang la/ mngon bajod ni ming btags pas 'jug pa yin la de'i bag chags kyi ka bum sogs ming 'dogs shes pa'o/ yang thal rang skabs gtan tshigs rang rgyud du bzhed mi bzhed ni spyir tshul gsum gnyis kas bzhed kyang*/ thal 'gyur bas tshul gsum nyid rang mtshan gyi grub par mi bzhed pa'i khyad par ro/ yang rang rgyud pas dgag bya bdag 'dzin gnyis la khyad par yod pas bdag med la yang phra rag yod par bzhed la/

skabs 'dir/ gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod du 'dzin pa'i lhan skyes bkag pa gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ chos rang gi mtshan nyid kyi grub pa don dam par 'gogs pa chos bdag (45)med du bzhes la/ thal 'gyur pas/ dgag bya gnyis ka rang bzhin gyi grub par 'dzin pa khyad par med pas phra rag med la// dgag gzhi bdag gnyis kyi sgo nas bdag med gnyis su dbye yang*/ spyi khyab rten 'brel nges pa'i gnad kyi sgos khyab gang zag gi bdag mes nges la/ rigs pa des nyan rang la chos bdag med rtogs pa'i sgrub pa'i rig pa'i rtsa ba yin gsung*/ rang rgyud pas gang zag rang mtshan gyi grub par 'dzin pa ni 'dzin tshul kyi sgo nas chos bdag tu bsdud dgos gsung*/ yang rang ni spyir shes pa gsal rig gi ngo bor skyes pa tsam zhig la rang myong tshul bzhag na kha nang kho nar phyogs pa'i 'dzin rnam yan gar ba rang rig mtshan nyid zhes gsung la sems tsam pa'i 'dod pa ltar rang rig bya rig byed kyi btag don btsal na mi rnyed do/ myong na rang myong dang (46)gzhan myong gnyis pu ni kha tshon mi chod de/ de gnyis myong ba'i btags don btsal na mi rnyed pa'i phyir ro/ zhes gsung*/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma'i skabs/ tha snyad dpes sgo nas nges par bya ste/ dper na sgyu ma'i snang ba la/ mig bslad ma bslad gnyis dang sgyu ma'i mkhan po rag nyis gsum las/ mig dag pa la shing rdol snang ba bzhin 'phags pa la snang med dang*/ mig bslad pa rta glang snang ba dang de rang mtshan par zhen pa ltar mong sdeb man chad 'dod la/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po la rta glang ma snang na sgyu ma'i rdzas sngags la nus pa med pas snang dgos la/ snang ba de la rta glang rang mtshan par mi 'dzin kyang*/ don la snang ba dang blo gnyis tshogs zhig yin pa bzhin 'dod gsung*/ sngags rim skabs/ mdo sngags gnyis ka lta bas ni mi 'phags ste shes rab ni ma bzhin 'phags bzhi (47)bskyed pa'i ma yin la/

dpe na mdo sngags gnyis ka thabs kyis sgo nas 'byed dgos la/ thabs de la mtshan nyid theg pa nas rgyu pha rol phyin pa drug rgyu'i sgo nas nyams su len la sngags nas 'bras ba'i rnam pa gnas lus 'khor dag mdzad pa bzhi'i sgo nas pha rol phyin pa drug gi 'bras bu'i sgo nas lam du byed pa ste gzung rnam lhar shar/ 'dzin stangs stong nyid du song ba'i bskyod pa'i rim pa rgya che bas khyad par 'phags par bzhed la/ 'di'i rnam pa lam du byed pa ni rnam smin gyi rgyu ma yin la nyer len gyi rgyu yin la bya rgyud la bskyed rim ji bzhin pa med na/ de'i 'bras bu

sangs rgyas kyi sku mtshan dpe'i rgyu lo dus na yi dam lhas byin gyis rlabs pa'i lus de'i rgyun yin par gsung la/ bla med la/ ye shes kyi gdangs kyi lus po lha'i rnam par bsgom pa de/ (48) gzugs sku'i rgyur bzhed do/ bya rgyud kyi bltas rgod sogs/ lam gyi stobs kyis bltas pa'i 'dod chags sogs lam du byed pas ni ma yin te/ de'i thabs mkhas de mdo la yang yod pa'i phyir gsungs/ dpe na bltas pa sogs kyi 'dod chags kyi lam gyi bog khyad khyad par 'dod pa des khyad par 'phags par gsungs/ bya rgyud kyi chu dbang gi dus bum chu spyi bor reg pa'i bde bas lus la khyab pa'i sems bde de dbang don du bzhed pas ye shes med do/ 'di'i chu dang cod pan gyi dbang du sa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang med pas sngags sdom ni med la/ rtsa ltung byang sems dang thun mong sdom bzung skabs dam tshig 'dzin pa tsam yod kyang*/ dam tshig nyams pas sngags kyi nus pa bri ba dang dngos grub 'gyang ba tsam las sdom pa mi gtong la/ byang chub sems rtsa ltung byung na sdom pa gtong bas sngags sdom (49)mtshan nyid pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la thob pas mes par bzhed/ bya rgyud skabs tha mal snang ba'i gnyen po rnam pa gsal ba dang*/ zhen pa'i gnyen po nga rgyal brtan pa gnyis ka dgos la/ dag rdzogs min gsum med pas rnam dag dran pa mi dgos gsungs/ lha drug skabs mtshan ma'i lha ni ting nge 'dzin dang bsam gtan gnyis yin la/ ting nge 'dzin ni dmigs pa re re nas sems 'dzin pa dang bsam gtan thams cad la dmigs pa yin la dpa' bos dmigs pa mang por sems 'dzin pa bsam gtan gyi gegs su gsung kyang*/ 'dir dmigs pa snga ma ma bor bar phyi ma snodan pa yin la/ bsam gtan gyi skyon du gsungs pa ni/ dmigs pa snga ma bor nas 'dzin stangs phyi mar spo ba yin pas snga ma la brtan pa thob dgos pa dgongs so/

'di'i bsdu rim (50)ni lha drug po mgo mjug bzlog pa dang po lhar dmigs pa bzhag nas sngags phreng la sems bzung de nas sngags bor nas sgra dang*/ de nas de kho na nyid la sems 'dzin pa yin gsungs/ 'dis lhas drug bsgom pa sku dang*/ mer gnas sgra gnas gsungs dang*/ sgra mtha'i thugs kyi rnal 'byor lam du bsgom pa yin pas mer gnas sogs kyi dgos pa dngos grub phra mo 'grub pa yin kyang gtso bo sems gnas pa'i thabs yin pas/ bsnyen pa yan gyi sems gnas brgyad pa yan grub nas tshogs lam gyi mgo dbang thob pa nas bsnyen pa'i yan tshogs lam chung ngu dang*/ mer gnas sgra gnas gnyis kyi tshogs lam phyi ma gnyis rjogs nas/ sgra mtha'i sgom dus tshogs sbyor gnyis ka'i mtshams nas rim gyis sgra mtha' rdzogs nas sbyor lam du zhi lhag zung 'jug mtshan nyid pa thob nas thun mongs dngos (51)grub/ tshe dang shes rab dang rdzu 'phrul gsum gyi thun mong gi dngos grub nges par sgrub nas mthong lam du 'phos nas/ de nas spangs rtogs rnams sa bcu ci lta bzhin bsgrod pa mtshan nyid theg pa dang mthun la sgrub tshul khyad par yod la/ de nas phyi rgyud gsum po lam sgrub pa'i gang zag gi blo'i khyad par re dang nang gses sgom pa'i khyad par phra mo ma gtogs bya rgyud dang 'dra la/ mthong mam man chad lha'i rnal 'byor sgom dgos la/ mthong lam thob nas yi dam gyi lha'i rnam par dngos su snang nas lam sgrub pa las sgom pa'i rnal 'byor min par gsung*/ ye shes kyi lus kyi dngos grub de mthong lam gyi rjes sam sngon du bsgrub kyang 'dra la don la ye shes kyi gangs ni ma yin la sems kyi bsdus pa yin la/ 'di'i phra mo'i thig ye sgom pa dang srog rtsol 'gogs (52)pa yod kyang sems gnas pa'i thabs las dbu mar gzung ba'i thabs med de rtsa'i gnad sgom pa med pa'i phyir ro/ rnal 'byor bla med skabs dang po phyi 'jug nas dbang bzhi'i bar rdzogs pas ni lam dang po 'jug pa dang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog ste bskyod rim la sems long du 'jug pa dang skabs kyi sgrib pa re dag pa'i dgos pa gnyis so/

'di'i lus dkyil ni lus la lha sgom pa tsam ma yin par lus yongs su gyur pa lhar sgom pa de/ don la lus ltar gnas pa de sgom pa yin gsungs/ bya spyod skabs mi dmigs pa dang lus kyi gor lha sgom pa dang 'di mi 'dra/ thun mong rigs lnga re re la dag bya dag byed kyi sgo nas lngar nges kyang de'i srog slob ma'i dbang yin la/ thun mong rigs lnga sems dang*/ slob dpon dbang ye shes kyi bsdus pa yin te rdo rje thabs sku dril bu shes rab gsung*/ de zung (53)du 'jug pa bde ba chen po gzugs kyi rnam par shar ba'i thugs ste gsum 'dzin pa yin/ don dam sems bskyed skabs bya spyod pas don dam pa gzugs kyi rnam par bzhengs pa las mi sgom pa la/ 'dis dbang don ji lta ba ngo sprad rgyu de 'di nas bsam dgos te/ kun rdzob byang sems zla ba dang don dam rdo rje gnyis po don la ngo bo mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes/ rlung gi ngo bo gzugs kyi rnam par shar ba'i don la rlung sems kyi gzugs rdo rje sgom pa 'di khyad par yin no/ nang bum dbang gis tshogs lam gyi smin byed dang*/ gsang dbang gis sgyu lus kyi smin byed sbyor lam dang*/ sher dbang gis mthong lam gyi mnyam bzhag snang med de/ dbang 'dis bde ba'i ros sems bcom pa'i rtog med dpe mtshon pas mthong lam gyi smin byed dang*/ bzhi pa tshig gi ngo spyod (54)ni mthong lam gyi rjes zung 'jug smin byed du 'gro la/ 'di tshigs gis ngo sprad pa las mi dgos te/ mthong lam dus ma dag sgyu lus rjes gzhig ril gzhig gnyis kyis bsdus nas mthong lam la snang mchad lugs ldog gis mnyam par 'jog de nas lugs 'byung gis phyir ldang*/ yang lug ldog gis ye shes la mnyam par bzhag pas zung 'jug 'grub pa tsam las mi dgos/ de ltar ma bsgom na mthong lam na thugs yod kyang lus med/ rjes thob na lus yod kyang thugs med pas dpe na mnyam par bzhag dgos/

mthong lam tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi sku de mnyam bzhag skabs bsdu ni mi dgos snang zhen ni med gsungs/ dpe na ya gnyis po zung du 'jug pa mthar thug gi bsgrub bya yin pa ngo sprad pa la tshig dbang zhes gsungs so/// /
